verdict.rationale: Apple's own docs describe vendor AI stack support (Metal ML acceleration, PyTorch backend on Metal, GPU Neural Accelerators, Core ML/Neural Engine for on-device LLMs) which shows first-party silicon-targeted AI tooling, but there is no explicit documentation or mention of mainstream community runtimes like llama.cpp, MLX, or ONNX Runtime naming M4 Max support. missing for 10: explicit llama.cpp/MLX/ONNX Runtime support statements, independent benchmarks confirming these runtimes run well on M4 Max GPU/NPU.
